title: KOKO Yacht
specs: 72-foot motor yacht with 3 cabins and 3 bathrooms
Activities include snorkeling, paddle boarding, wakeboarding, tubing, swimming, board games, and movie library
Personal chef and crew provide 5-star service
Children must wear life jackets on deck
Not wheelchair accessible; stairs to cabins and deck
Up to 12 passengers for sunset charter; 2-6 guests for 6-day charter

services.name: Charter KOKO
services.desc: Explore the hidden splendor of the Caribbean aboard your own private yacht. KOKO offers exciting itineraries in St. Martin, St. Barts and Anguilla. You choose a charter. We do the rest. Charter KOKO for an afternoon sunset cruise, full-day adventure, or plan a dream vacation on a 4-day or 6-day

includes: Food, beverages, fuel, dock fees, use of yacht tender and onboard toys
Gourmet meals and snacks prepared by private chef
blurb: Guests charter a 72-foot motor yacht with 3 crew members including a private chef. The yacht offers island itineraries in St. Martin, St. Barts, and Anguilla with activities like snorkeling, paddle boarding, wakeboarding, and tubing. The crew handles provisioning, cooking, cleaning, and can arrange off-yacht adventures.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking; full payment and APA due 120 days before charter · APA includes 10% crew gratuity; additional 5-10% suggested for exemplary service · Itineraries subject to change due to weather or Captain's discretion · Starts in St. Martin or St. Barts harbor · Operates 10 months per year, 2 months maintenance
